detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(le.device_type) LIKE '%MOBILE%' 
AND UPPER(le.device_type) LIKE '%DESKTOP%' 
AND le.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND t.instrument IN ('CRYPTO', 'FOREX') 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
AND u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT device_type) AS device_count, user_agent, STDDEV(amount_usd) AS std_dev FROM transactions GROUP BY user_id ) AS subquery WHERE device_count >= 8 AND user_agent != (SELECT user_agent FROM transactions WHERE user_id = subquery.user_id GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_agent) DESC LIMIT 1) AND std_dev > (SELECT AVG(amount_usd) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = subquery.user_id) * 0.2)
detections.recommendation: Try broadening your search criteria or checking if the data for this period is available.

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(*) as txn_count, 
  SUM(t.amount_usd) as total_usd, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_count, 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 as failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t 
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
  AND UPPER(t.status) = 'FAILED' 
  AND u.risk_score > 70 
  AND u.account_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 > 18 
  AND SUM(t.amount_usd) > 250000 
  AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.instrument) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) >= 4 
  AND (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t2.instrument IN (SELECT instrument FROM transactions WHERE user_id = t.user_id AND created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) THEN t2.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(t2.amount_usd)) * 100 > 35

SELECT u.user_id, u.full_name, u.risk_level, u.risk_score, t.instrument, t.amount, t.created_at 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(u.risk_level) IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND UPPER(t.instrument) IN ('CRYPTO', 'FOREX') 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
AND u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM ( SELECT user_id, instrument, amount, created_at, SUM(amount_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at ROWS BETWEEN 90 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum, COUNT(instrument) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS instrument_count, SUM(CASE WHEN instrument IN ('CRYPTO', 'FOREX') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS crypto_forex_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN instrument IN ('CRYPTO', 'FOREX') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at ROWS BETWEEN 90 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS crypto_forex_running_sum FROM transactions ) AS subquery WHERE instrument_count >= 3 AND (crypto_forex_sum / SUM(amount_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id)) * 100 > 25 AND (crypto_forex_running_sum / running_sum) * 100 > 25 )
